title: Elegy
description: A beautiful student (Penélope Cruz) throws into disarray the life of an aging lecturer and cultural critic (Ben Kingsley) when she awakens in him feelings of sexual possessiveness.

title: The Exorcist III: Legion
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: The Getaway
description: An explosives-expert thief (Alec Baldwin) and his wife (Kim Basinger) cross a crime lord and are chased to the Mexican border.

title: Big Fan
description: A football fan (Patton Oswalt) meets his idol in a New York strip club, where his rabid devotion is put to the test and events take a suddenly violent turn.

title: Yakuza Wolf 2
description: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

title: Eat My Dust!
description: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

title: Aguirre: The Wrath of God
description: Power-mad Aguirre (Klaus Kinski) leads an ill-fated raft party from Pizarro's 16th-century Amazon expedition.

title: The Road to Wellville
description: Dr. John Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) treats a young couple (Bridget Fonda, Matthew Broderick) for their imagined ailments at his Michigan sanitorium circa 1907.

title: The Loft
description: Paranoia grips a group of married men (Karl Urban, James Marsden, Wentworth Miller) who find the dead body of an unknown woman in the penthouse they share for extramarital trysts.

title: A Fantastic Fear of Everything
description: Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

title: The Long Good Friday
description: A Cockney crime czar (Bob Hoskins) and his mistress (Helen Mirren) answer a threat on the eve of his big deal with a U.S. mobster (Eddie Constantine).

title: An Eye for an Eye
description: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

title: Brain on Fire
description: Susannah Cahalan, an up-and-coming journalist at the New York Post, became plagued by voices in her head and seizures. As weeks progress and Susannah quickly moves deeper into insanity, her behaviors shift from violence to catatonia.

title: Animal Factory
description: Sentenced to the state penitentiary for dealing drugs, a middle-class young man (Edward Furlong) seeks protection from a savvy inmate (Willem Dafoe).

title: Bodyguards and Assassins
description: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

title: The Stunt Man
description: An all-knowing director (Peter O'Toole) toys with a fugitive's (Steve Railsback) mind after making him stuntman on a movie set.

title: Triple 9
description: Criminals and some crooked cops hatch a devious scheme to use an honest lawman as a pawn for a heist.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Homicide
description: A Jewish cop faces a crisis of conscience when he learns a shopkeeper may have been killed by an anti-Semitic group.

title: Escape to Athena
description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

title: Take Me Home Tonight
description: A directionless college grad (Topher Grace) sees a chance to win the girl of his dreams when she invites him to a huge end-of-summer party.

title: Itsy Bitsy
description: An ancient mysterious relic unleashes a giant prehistoric spider that terrorizes a single mother and her two children in their new house.

title: House
description: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion, where supernatural events occur almost immediately.

title: Fifty Shades of Black
description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," wealthy entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) introduces a young woman (Kali Hawk) to his kinky world of S&M.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: The owner of a haunted mansion offers a group of people reward money if they can survive a night at his scary estate.

title: Blind Horizon
description: An injured man (Val Kilmer) who cannot remember the past thinks he is involved in a plot to assassinate the president.

title: Once Upon a Time in China III
description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: Piranha
description: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: After Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Mary is visited by the angel Gabriel, who tells her she will bear the Son of God; Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem to take part in Herod's census, where Jesus is born.

title: Serving Sara
description: A woman (Elizabeth Hurley) tries to persuade a process server (Matthew Perry) to help her turn the tables on her conniving husband (Bruce Campbell).

title: Hopscotch
description: An ex-CIA agent (Walter Matthau) and his lover (Glenda Jackson) write a book about the agency, one jump ahead of agents sent to stop them.

title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
description: Filmmaker Ed Wood Jr.'s laughable tale of alien invaders and resurrected corpses in the San Fernando Valley.

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: All I See Is You
description: In Bangkok, a young blind woman undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores sight to her right eye. Able to see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes her husband feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

title: Red Riding: 1974
description: A rookie crime reporter (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a missing-child case that mirrors that of a series of child abductions and murders that took place in previous years.

title: A Better Tomorrow II
description: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

title: Season of the Witch
description: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.

title: Filly Brown
description: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

title: C.H.U.D.
description: Lovers (John Heard, Kim Greist) and other New Yorkers face cannibalistic humanoid underground dwellers, spawned by toxic waste.

title: Red Headed Stranger
description: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie; however, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

title: Silver City
description: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.
